Whether you enjoy fine food and wine, outdoor adventures, or a welcoming regional lifestyle, Clare is an exceptional place to live and work.

Clare Renal Dialysis Service - Quality Care, Close to Home

The Clare Renal Dialysis Service provides safe, high-quality haemodialysis care in a welcoming and supportive environment, allowing people living with chronic kidney disease to receive treatment closer to home.

Located at Clare Hospital, our dedicated renal unit offers nurse-supported maintenance dialysis in a comfortable setting, reducing the need for frequent travel to metropolitan centres. Working in partnership with the Central and Northern Adelaide Renal and Transplantation Service (CNARTS), patients also have access to specialist nephrology care through visiting consultants and telehealth services when required.

Our experienced and compassionate team is committed to delivering personalised care that supports each patient's health, independence, and wellbeing. Local dialysis care in the heart of the Clare Valley.

Registration or eligibility for enrolment as a Nurse with the Nursing and Midwifery Board of Australia and hold, or be eligible to hold, a current practicing certificate.

Please contact us, if you have any queries. Further information please see: Addressing vaccine preventable disease: Occupational assessment, screening and vaccination policy and in the application to help guide you.

JOB SUMMARY:
The Vessel Master will carry out duties as directed by the General Manager or Farm Managers.

Approximate start date: December 2026 & January 2027, AFE will be taking successful candidates throughout 2026/27 for these positions. Employment may be up to 4 years.

Periods at sea are varied and weather dependent. Hours of operation are determined by the daily operational needs. Farm vessels can be required to conduct operations year round from land based sites out to the farming site. The season begins in December finishing with the annual harvest period throughout June, July & August.

•	Ensure crew work in such a way, to minimize risks to their health, safety, and others.
•	Being involved in and overseeing the induction and ongoing training of crew and ensure safe work practices are continually developed and maintained. Ensure that all training is recorded on communication forms and passed on to the Farm Manager.
•	Ensuring that only employees and approved maintenance contractors come onboard or attend any work sites. 
•	Documenting bait received, fed out, uneaten feed and daily fish behaviour. 
•	Report daily to the Farm Manager.
•	Directing and training crew on feeding in accordance with daily feed plans and correct feeding techniques.

•	Keeping the vessel clean, tidy, and safe with safety and spare equipment accessible and organized.
•	Ensuring the engine room is operating properly.  The skipper is ultimately responsible for the whole vessel.
•	Routinely checking all is in order and secure and dry in the chain locker, void spaces, bilge, steering compartment etc. (This is just basic seamanship and neglecting this responsibility is not acceptable).
•	Routinely checking lifting gear is in a safe state (blocks, wire, ropes, shackles, hoses).
•	Ensuring vessel is berthed properly and manned sufficiently, not leaving inexperienced deckhands to be responsible for securing the vessel.

Job Description – Practice Nurse
Job title: Practice Nurse	Reports to: Head Nurse 
                        Chief Executive Officer
Purpose of position
To ensure smooth and efficient functioning of the practice and provide an exceptional standard of care to our patients.

Responsibilities 

Clinical
•	Perform clinical duties within required level of clinical competency, according to best available evidence.  Explain procedures to patients, providing them with support and reassurance.  Duties include triage, immunisations and other injections; wound management, chronic disease management, ECG’s and collection of pathology samples.  Assist doctors with clinical procedures.  Maintain clinical documentation.
•	Oversee cold chain process, awareness, responsibilities and documentation of cold chain process.
•	Monitor infection control standards and implement changes / educate.

Patient Services
•	Assist with triage, data management, diagnostic services, networking with other providers, planning & management of patient care and patient advocacy.  Telephone patients with test results as directed by medical staff.  

Improvement of Patient Health Outcomes
•	Conduct preventative/screening procedures; assist with patient education and community health promotion activities.  Co-ordinate patient recall and outreach programs and GP management plans and team care arrangement.  

Equipment and Supplies
•	Maintain stocks of clinical supplies, including correct storage (such as refrigeration), removal of out-of-date stock and ordering supplies.  Provide input in purchasing relevant clinical equipment and supplies.
•	Assist with stock ordering bi – monthly
•	Assist with monthly vaccine order
•	Complete daily job allocation sheet
•	Check emergency trolley daily
•	Check O2 therapy as per job description
•	Monitor cold chain process twice daily

Compliance
•	Maintain awareness of current and new legislation to ensure business is complying with all statutory and regulatory obligations including infection control, sterilisation, hazardous materials & safe handling/disposal of medical waste, records management, OHS, and accreditation.  Ensure relevant personnel are kept informed and changes are made to systems and procedures as required.  

Professional
•	Act within the practice and nursing code of ethics & appropriate level of clinical competence at all times.  Maintain awareness of current evidence and research on clinical practices and inform/educate other practice staff. Change systems and procedures to ensure compliance with best available evidence as applicable.  

OHS
•	Consistently be aware of OHS requirements and comply with them.

General
Delegation of tasks to other medical and non-medical staff. 
Assist with other practice duties as required.  

Expected behaviours and personal attributes 
•	Demonstrate a knowledge of and compliance with all relevant legislation and common law obligations affecting nursing.
•	Discharge of duty of care in the course of practice including meeting practice standards, and accountability for nursing actions.
•	Demonstrate knowledge of policies and procedural guidelines that have legal implications, for example, ensure documentation conforms to legal requirements.
•	Practice only within the limits of their educational preparation and competence.
•	Identify and respond to unsafe practice, for example, implement interventions to prevent unsafe practice and/or contravention of law.
•	Demonstrated patient-focused approach in service provision with genuine empathy and interest in their needs.
•	Excellent interpersonal and communication skills across all ages and social groups.
•	Be always well presented, friendly, courteous and obliging.  Represent the practice in a confident and positive manner at all times. 
•	Undertake all duties in a diligent manner, with honesty and integrity, 
•	Maintain absolute confidentiality regarding patient and practice information.
•	Have a vigilant attitude to accuracy, being prepared to double check as necessary.
•	Ability to work cooperatively and independently. & ability to prioritise and organise, with attention to detail.
•	Demonstrated commitment to ongoing professional development
•	This position requires physical ability to occasionally lift and/or move patients.
•	Possession of current driver’s licence (include only if essential to perform job, such as home visits)

Education, Qualifications and Experience  
Essential:
•	Appropriate tertiary qualification & registration certificate. 
•	Professional indemnity cover.
•	Minimum of one year of nursing experience, preferably in a community-based role.
•	Demonstrated understanding of the needs of general practice and interest in community-based nursing including patient education and health promotion.
•	Knowledge of current immunisation schedules, Diabetes management, asthma management, enhanced primary care items, infection control, CPR and emergency resuscitation techniques, equipment & drugs.

Desirable:
•	Competence in the use of relevant equipment & software – be specific, give brand-names if appropriate. 
•	Experience in similar role as practice nurse or community-based nursing.
•	Experience with specific social groups serviced by practice, such as adolescents, aged care, migrant or refuge groups, aboriginals & Torres Straight islanders, etc.
•	Additional qualifications such as Accredited Women’s Health Certificate, Diabetes Education Certificate, Asthma/Spirometry qualification/education.
•	Member of APNA.

Hours Of Work
As per fortnightly roster 
Weekend & Public Holiday work as rostered   
However it is expected that our staff will work extra time on occasions if this is required to deliver essential patient care.
Breaks:  30 minutes for lunch and 10 minutes each for morning and afternoon tea to be taken in shifts with other staff to ensure continuity of care. 

Other features: 
 
Professional development provided or expected.
Requirement for use of own vehicle, if essential to the position.
Potential for contact with hazardous material such as blood & body fluids.
May be required to have some immunisations.

We are seeking a skilled Electrical Engineering Technician to join their dynamic team. In this role, you will play a crucial part in supporting the design, installation, and maintenance of electrical systems for heavy machinery, substations, and industrial control systems. You will work closely with engineers and technologists to ensure all electrical installations meet industry standards, safety regulations, and project specifications.

This is an exciting opportunity for a detail-oriented professional with strong technical skills and a passion for electrical systems within an industrial and structural engineering environment.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Design & Documentation:
• Prepare detailed electrical drawings, schematics, and layout plans for industrial installations, including substations, switchgear, motor control systems, and cabling networks.
• Develop wiring diagrams and termination schedules for control panels used in heavy machinery & manufacturing and automation systems.

Technical Support:
• Assist electrical engineers in the design, testing, and optimization of electrical systems for machinery & manufacturing and structural projects.
• Troubleshoot and diagnose faults in PLC-controlled systems, including servo drives and variable frequency drives (VFDs).

Testing & Analysis:
• Conduct electrical tests, perform complex calculations, and analyse data to validate system performance.
• Perform insulation resistance (IR) testing, earth continuity checks, and thermal imaging on high-voltage equipment.

Cost Estimation:
• Assist in estimating material quantities, costs, and project timelines.
• Evaluate supplier quotations for electrical components (e.g., circuit breakers, contactors) to ensure cost-effective procurement.

Quality Assurance:
• Inspect electrical installations and finished products for compliance with specifications.
• Verify that all electrical work adheres to AS/NZS 3000 and IEC standards before commissioning.

Installation & Maintenance:
• Assemble, install, calibrate, and repair electrical equipment, including protection relays and metering devices.
• Perform preventive maintenance on industrial motor control centres (MCCs) to minimize downtime.

Workshop Operations:
• Undertake workshop duties, including wiring, testing, and modifying electrical assemblies.
• Fabricate and test custom control panels for machinery integration.

Research & Development:
• Contribute to R&D initiatives by assisting in experimental programs.
• Assist in the testing and integration of renewable energy systems (e.g., solar inverters) into industrial power networks.

SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS:
• Trade Certification or Diploma in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field.
• Proven experience in electrical drafting, machinery wiring, or industrial electrical systems and manufacturing fabrications.
• Proficiency in CAD software (e.g., AutoCAD Electrical) for schematic and layout design.
• Strong analytical skills with the ability to perform technical calculations and interpret test data.
• Knowledge of industry standards, including AS/NZS 3000 and electrical safety regulations.
• Hands-on experience with motor controls, switchgear, PLCs, and protection systems is highly desirable.
• Workshop & fabrication skills, including the ability to assemble and troubleshoot electrical components.
• Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with engineers and project teams.
• At least 2 years of Full-time on the job work experience.

WHY APPLY?
• Work with a forward-thinking company at the forefront of industrial and structural engineering.
• Engage in high-impact projects involving cutting-edge electrical systems.
• Opportunities for professional growth and skill development.
• Competitive remuneration and a supportive team environment.

If you are a motivated Electrical Engineering Technician with a passion for precision and innovation, we encourage you to apply! Submit your resume and a cover letter outlining your relevant experience.
